title: Make ZhongHe Great Again
synopsis: When Liu Ben crosses paths with an unexpected partner, Ma Jie, the two unlikely underdogs join forces to navigate the challenges of the modern workplace. Through a series of bold and unconventional moves, they set out to uncover the hidden rules behind climbing the corporate ladder. Together, this perfectly mismatched duo attempts to crack the code to success and beat the system at its own game.

synopsis_lang.en: When Liu Ben crosses paths with an unexpected partner, Ma Jie, the two unlikely underdogs join forces to navigate the challenges of the modern workplace. Through a series of bold and unconventional moves, they set out to uncover the hidden rules behind climbing the corporate ladder. Together, this perfectly mismatched duo attempts to crack the code to success and beat the system at its own game.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
眾和集團分公司熱血小組長劉奔（張若昀 飾），一心衝刺晉升，意外重逢經歷過年會風波、深諳職場生存法則的老員工馬傑（白客 飾），二人結成“劉馬組合”，立下同步升職的約定。


兩人捲入公司部門優化、AI崗位衝擊、形式主義加班等各類職場亂象，接連上演荒誕爆笑的闖關鬧劇。在層層內卷、人情應酬的現實困境中，二人一路互相扶持，最終跳出功利化晉升執念，認清工作的真正意義，找到屬於打工人的自我價值。

cast: Ruoyun Zhang, Ke Bai, Chloe Gao, Da Peng, Dafei Zhuang, Yizhou Sun
